notes.title: New build
notes.content:
Hi guys,

I know it's been more than a year since I released this VN, but I released a new build of this VN today.
The artist, Selly, has improved a lot since she did the art for this VN (especially the backgrounds), so she decided to redo a few art pieces.
The old sound effects were also bothering me, so I updated a few of the SFX so they're cleaner and of higher quality.
I hope you enjoy it!

As the VN has been translated into a couple of languages, I'm not sure if this update will break any of the patches or not. As I only swapped out a few files, however, this (hopefully) shouldn't be an issue!

- ebi x

notes.title: Lily of the Valley release
notes.content:
Hi guys,

I've released a new visual novel on Steam with artwork by SillySelly (the same artist as Emmeline Burns). If you're fond of her artwork, please check it out!

http://store.steampowered.com/app/628460/Lily_of_the_Valley/

Lily is a short, gloomy story about a young man who meets a mysterious young girl. Set in Wales, its main themes are: the importance of family, the inevitability of death, and the deliciousness of doughnuts.

Given it's a short VN, it can be purchased for $2.99. I hope you enjoy it!

As a side note: the artist for Emmeline has improved in the last two years, so she decided to redo a bunch of the old art assets for Emmeline. I'm going to upload a new build of Emmeline in a week or so with prettier, updated art for you to enjoy!

- ebi x

notes.title: This World Unknown Released
notes.content:
My newest visual novel, This World Unknown, has been released on Steam!
'Newest' might not be the right turn of phrase, though, since I was working on it for a long time...

This World Unknown is a long fantasy otome game. The writing style and content is rather dissimilar from Emmy, and the art is also quite different... but if you like my writing, you might find it interesting.

It also allows more choice than Emmy does, and has an actual branching storyline with four different paths.

You can check it out here, if you are so inclined:
http://store.steampowered.com/app/521540

- Ebi x

tags.feature: - It also allows more choice than Emmy does, and has an actual branching storyline with four different paths.

notes.title: Empty Horizons released
notes.content:
Hi guys,

I thought I would let you know, my latest VN, Empty Horizons, has been released on Steam! It was made by the same team who put Emmy together (same writer/artist/composer), though tonally Emmy and EH are not that similar... Emmy has this deliberate archaic-ness to the prose, while in EH it's a bit more modern. Even so, if you like the writing, art, and music in Emmy, then you might find Empty Horizons to your liking.

Also, it has achievements and trading cards, because I know people care about those.

http://store.steampowered.com/app/496630/

- Ebi x

notes.title: Update
notes.content:
Hi, guys. I just uploaded a new build of Emmy, which should have a few more fixed typos (thanks to Chazz the Elder and notonion for spotting them for me!) There's nothing else in the update other than fixed typos, so don't get too excited.

If you have any issues with launching the VN after the update, please tell me. And, if you find any more typos, feel free to tell me that, too!

- Ebi
